expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Four days for a first taste of the island: a night in Kandy with the elephants and the Tooth Relic temple, then two nights by the sea in Colombo with a free afternoon and a full day of the capital. Easy to pair with direct flights from Hyderabad, Chennai or Bengaluru.
included: Included: 3 nights in standard and deluxe class hotels with breakfast daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; a private Pinnawala elephant sanctuary visit; a private half day Kandy sightseeing tour; a private full day Colombo sightseeing tour. Entrance tickets are payable locally.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches and dinners; entrance tickets; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
